title.narrative: Lifesaving response to the populations most affected by flooding and cholera in Bardheere Gedo region through emergency WASH interventions.

description.narrative:
ltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:"gtMore than 21 people, 6 of them children reportedly died as moderate to heavy rains started in Bardheere. Heavy rains have been reported in several districts in Gedo, Lower and Middle and in the Ethiopian highlands, leading to a rise of water levels.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gt
lt/pgtltp style="mso-margin-top-alt:automso-margin-bottom-alt:auto line-height:normal" class="MsoNormal"gtAccording toltspan style="font-size:12.0ptfont-family:"gt assessment carried out by an inter-agency team on 26 March and led by the Area Humanitarian Coordination Group (AHCG), more than 13,000 families (about 80,000 people) which close to 40 percent of the total population were affected by the recent rains, of these, 8,945 families (about 53,000 people) were internally displaced. According to SWALLIM, the river levels in most of flood prone areas across the Juba has either surpassed. According to this assessment, it estimated that all 8,945 displaced people’s shelter were either destroyed or damaged while 272 other facilities including health centers, schools and latrines were also either damaged or destroyed. Over 1,000 hectares of farmland was affected, and learning was disrupted for over 3,000 pupilslt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gt
lt/pgtltp style="mso-margin-top-alt:automargin-bottom:9.95pt line-height:normal" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptfont-family:"gtTo response this situation, ARD proposed project will cover WASH needs of flood/AWD affected men, women, boys and girls. A total of 20,000 flood affected men, women and children including the disabilities, marginalized communities and IDPs will benefit safe drinking water and will have access equally through:ltbrgt 1) Rehabilitation of flood damaged water tank to provide access of safe water to 5,000 flood affected people living in Bardheere districtlt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gt
lt/pgtltp style="mso-margin-top-alt:automargin-bottom:9.95pt line-height:normal" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptfont-family:"gt2) Provision of emergency clean water to 3000 flood affected people through voucher for a period of 30 days.ltbrgt 3) Capacity building of 42 gender balanced WASH Committees members shared equality by men and women on operation and maintenance of developed water infrastructures shall be throughout the project implementation period, to ensure the sustainability of the developed water facilities after the project is faced out. ltbrgt 4) Provision of reliable and sustainable access to proper sanitation services through construction of 170 emergency flood proof latrines to cover the huge sanitation gaps in Bardheere iDPs. The latrines will be gender separated and flood proof with lockable doors and hand washing basins. Construction of latrines will be implemented through market-based programming. At least, 15% of the emergency latrines will be designed for people with disability living in the IDPs. All sanitation facilities will be close dwellings and will have lock inside and outsideltbrgt 5) Distribution of 60 sanitation sets to 6 IDP camps, in order to improve the environmental sanitation of the targeted locations. The aim of the 60 sanitation sets distribution is to carry out clean-up campaigns, in order to reduce the spread of AWD/cholera diseases and to improve the environmental sanitation of the target locations.ltbrgt 6) Conducting comprehensive hygiene promotion campaigns focusing hand washing with soap practices to 20,000 men, women, boys and girls through visiting house to house, health facilities, and nutrition centers.lt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gt
lt/pgtltp style="mso-margin-top-alt:automso-margin-bottom-alt:auto line-height:normal" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptfont-family:"gt7) ARD will also train 15 Community Hygiene Promoters shared equally men and women, selected from the target communities and IDPs, so that in their turn can educate the entire population to change their behaviors. ltbrgt 8) Distribution of 2000 HP kits to 2000 IDP HHs. ltbrgt All the project equipment and materials will be purchased locally and the skilled workers from drought affected communities will be recruited to improve local communities’ livelihoods and to strengthen local markets through the market-based programming initiatives. In addition, ARD will ensure mainstreaming protection including mitigation measures against GBV in all phases of the project. This project will also promote and empower women participation in different activities such as the management of constructed WASH facilities. lt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gt
